name: Giant, Frostkin
body:
Frostkin Giant CR 7

XP 3,200
CE Large humanoid (giant)
Init +0; Senses low-light vision; Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 9, flat-footed 22 (+4 armor, +9 natural, –1 size)
hp 76 (9d8+36)
Fort +11, Ref +2, Will +3
Immune cold
Weaknesses vulnerability to fire

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft. (30 ft. in armor)
Melee greataxe +14/+9 (2d8+7) or 2 slams +14 (1d8+7)
Ranged rock +7 (1d8+10)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 25; Dex 10; Con 19; Int 10; Wis 12; Cha 11
Base Atk +7; CMB +15; CMD 24
Feats Cleave, Martial Weapon Proficiency (greataxe), Power Attack, Weapon Focus (greataxe)
Skills Climb +11, Craft (any one) +9, Intimidate +7, Perception +12, Stealth +3 (+7 in snow); Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth in snow
Languages Common, Giant

ECOLOGY

Environment cold mountains
Organization solitary, gang (2–5), band (6–8), tribe (9-30 plus 1 barbarian or ranger jarl of 6th-8th level)
Treasure standard (chain shirt, greataxe, other treasure)

Frostkin are the smaller, less aggressive cousins of frost giants. They are more neutral in outlook, and also more curious about other humanoids. Frostkin equal in intelligence to frost giants, and will engage in combat only when they retain an advantage or are provoked. Frostkin are less prone to the wanton bloodlust and rage that their frost giant kin exhibit, but are still highly feared and capable in combat.

Frostkin can sometimes be employed as guardians, enforcers, or other mercenary roles. Since frostkin harbor a strong sense of self-survival and independence, their employers need to be able to control the frostkin via force, magic, or outright manipulation.

Frostkin stand around 13 feet tall and weighs about 1,250 pounds. Frostkin can live to be 250 years old.
